card.name: Second digit of a year
card.fires_on: The second digit of a four-digit year, most often the 7 in an 18th-century date such as 1719 or 1726, in birth and death dates. It also fires on digits in other numbers such as zip codes.

modes.label: Year in a life-span
modes.description: The century digit (often 7) of a birth or death year in a biography.

modes.label: Other number digits
modes.description: A digit inside a zip code or report number.

card.plain: It marks the second digit of a year, usually in 1700s dates, as the model reads a person's birth and death years.
